economic_thesis: After subtracting the contemporaneous eligible-crypto median return, medium/slow relative leaders and laggards should persist when the common crypto path is directional, while six-bar relative overshoots should revert when that path is inefficient. A causal efficiency mixture and balanced rank sleeves should express both effects without market direction or funding carry.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Directional mixing emphasizes continuation; persistent residual losers populate the short sleeve, which must contribute positively in bear observations.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Directional mixing emphasizes continuation; residual leaders populate the long sleeve, which must contribute positively in bull observations.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Low path efficiency emphasizes six-bar residual reversal; the combined balanced book must contribute positively.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own the five highest causal ensemble ranks at 0.08 each and satisfy all frozen long-side activity, notional, and bull-attribution gates.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the five lowest causal ensemble ranks at -0.08 each and satisfy all frozen short-side activity, notional, and bear-attribution gates.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Maintain balanced raw targets while organizer-owned next-open volatility, drawdown, position-stop, and turnover controls are evaluated prospectively.

falsifier: Reject or pivot if any development, team-declared A5 score, regime, sleeve, fold, quarter, doubled-cost, concentration, or neighborhood gate fails; if adaptive mixing is not robust relative to pure-mode controls; or if removing cross-sectional residualization does not weaken the proposed mechanism. DNF rather than submit a negative model.
mechanism: At each 8h close, subtract the eligible-crypto cross-sectional median return, compute studentized residual sums over 6/18/63 bars, robustly standardize them, and mix medium/slow continuation with fast reversal using a causal 63-bar common-market path-efficiency share. Rank deterministically into equal-gross five-coin long and short sleeves.
risk_policy_plan: Run the reference first with root no-control risk_policy.json. All controls remain dormant unless that core passes every official non-neighbor gate and the exact activation minima in qualification_thresholds.json: base return >0, base Sharpe >=0.75, doubled return >0, doubled Sharpe >=0.35, at least four of six positive folds, positive bull/bear/chop and long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop attribution, and all numeric sleeve floors. Controls cannot rescue failure. Before any later policy commit, registration, and run, copy its immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json because the lifecycle reads only that path.
selection_metric: Non-compensatory development qualification first; among passers only, prefer trial-adjusted probability positive, doubled-cost Sharpe, worst-regime Sharpe, neighborhood median Sharpe, and lower positive-PnL concentration in that order. No failing or negative candidate may be selected.

economic_thesis: Moderate deviations from a causal volume-weighted price anchor should converge among liquid, non-extreme crypto contracts. Requiring a crash-quarantined cohort, residual confirmation, a daily schedule, and buffered incumbent ranks should avoid the unbounded rebound hazard and churn of the terminal 8h trend/reversion rank book while preserving balanced relative-value sleeves.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Moderately premium coins with negative residual confirmation populate the short sleeve; extreme crashers are quarantined rather than chased short.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Moderately discounted coins with positive residual confirmation populate the long sleeve and participate in broad recovery without directional net exposure.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Both moderate discounts and premiums converge toward their volume-weighted anchors, providing the mechanism's primary two-sided role.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own four crash-quarantined anchor discounts at 0.025 each and satisfy every long activity/notional and bull-attribution gate.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short four crash-quarantined anchor premiums at -0.025 each and satisfy every short activity/notional and bear-attribution gate.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Tail quarantine removes recent gaps, extreme cumulative moves, deep drawdowns, broad price ranges, and excessive volatility before scoring; the no-control book remains 0.20 gross and zero net.

falsifier: Reject pivot-01 if it becomes insolvent, if any no-control numeric development/A5/regime/role/sleeve/stability gate fails, if the tail-quarantine or volume-anchor ablations do not support the stated mechanism, or if the complete fixed neighborhood is fragile. Controls cannot rescue failure; use the remaining pivot allowance or DNF.
mechanism: At 00:00 UTC each day, form exact 8h histories for the A6 eligible crypto universe; quarantine recent gap, tail, drawdown, range, volume, and volatility extremes; measure each remaining coin's residual distance from a 63-bar volume-weighted log-price anchor plus nine-bar market-residual confirmation; expose that exact expected-return score to A5; select four moderate discounts long and four premiums short with a two-rank incumbent buffer. Unchanged sleeves return hold rather than rebalance.
risk_policy_plan: Pivot-01 is no-control-first with root risk_policy.json byte-identical to risk_policies/no-control.json. No control may rescue the terminal initial family or a failed pivot core. A later policy remains forbidden unless this core passes every numeric activation and official non-neighbor gate, followed by policy-matched noncircular stability evidence.
selection_metric: All non-compensatory gates first. Among no-control passers only, prefer doubled-cost Sharpe, worst-regime Sharpe, positive fold/quarter breadth, A5 pooled score correlation, neighborhood median Sharpe, and lower positive-PnL concentration; never select a negative or insolvent candidate.

economic_thesis: Persistent cross-sectional funding pressure measures paid positioning imbalance. Contracts with the highest positive pressure contain crowded longs that pay carry and are vulnerable to unwind, while contracts with the lowest or negative pressure contain crowded shorts or cheap long exposure. A balanced weekly book can collect funding-transfer asymmetry and price normalization with far fewer decisions than the failed daily price-anchor family.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The short sleeve holds the most persistently positive-funded crowded-long contracts, receives their funding transfers, and targets price unwind during broad risk reduction.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The long sleeve holds the lowest or negative-funded contracts, avoids the market's most expensive longs, and targets short-covering or under-owned participation.
expected_regime_roles.chop: The dollar-balanced book targets recurring cross-sectional funding transfer and crowding normalization without requiring a market direction.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Own four lowest-pressure eligible native-crypto contracts at 0.015 each and independently satisfy long activity, notional, and bull-attribution gates.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short four highest-pressure eligible native-crypto contracts at -0.015 each and independently satisfy short activity, notional, and bear-attribution gates.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Exact price-history admissibility and funding-event validity exclude discontinuous or stale observations; 0.12 gross, zero net, and a weekly schedule are intrinsic construction, not a risk overlay.

falsifier: This is Team 10's final mechanism pivot. Reject and record DNF if it becomes insolvent; produces missing metrics; or fails any no-control development, A5, regime, role, sleeve, cost, fold, or quarter gate. Controls, ablations, and neighbors are forbidden and cannot rescue the result. Team 10 cannot assert formal qualification without organizer-authorized official stability evidence.
mechanism: Every 168 hours from the Unix-epoch anchor, use only A6-authorized native-crypto members; stablecoin bases and tokenized or synthetic TradFi securities, commodities, metals, and indexes are excluded even when exchange-listed as perpetuals. Require exact past-closed 8h price histories and valid, nonstale funding events from the prior 14 days. For each coin, add cumulative funding transfer to a frozen persistence term, robustly normalize that pressure across the cross section, negate it into expected return, and expose the exact finite dict once to A5. Select four low-pressure names long and four high-pressure names short with a two-rank retention buffer. Unchanged sleeves return hold.
risk_policy_plan: Final pivot-02 is no-control only. Root risk_policy.json must be byte-identical to risk_policies/no-control.json. No volatility target, drawdown brake, stop, turnover control, combined control, or neighbor is authorized before or after its result.
selection_metric: No selection occurs: exactly one frozen final candidate exists. Every gate is non-compensatory; a strong metric cannot offset a failed return, A5, regime, role, sleeve, cost, fold, quarter, drawdown, or Calmar requirement.
